title: Document Extraction Response
description: Response emitted by POST /applications/{id}/documents/{doc_id}/fields upon executing schema-driven extraction, date policy normalization, bounding-box grounding, and completeness evaluation (Guide §11.2 S6, §11.3 S6b).

doc_type.description: Classified document type (e.g. FIRE_NOC, ACCREDITATION, EOA_LETTER)

completeness_status.description: Completeness status based on required fields extraction and validation

missing_fields.description: List of required fields missing or invalid

facts.description: Extracted and grounded C3 typed facts

idempotent_cached.description: True if served from database cache

reason.description: Reason in case of incomplete or unclassified status
